Today, I’m going to lay out a clear, structured approach that focuses on discipline, strategy, and repetition — the same way I’ve trained thousands of students to build […]

item.title: Chart of the Week: How AI Becomes Universal
item.description: To date, AI has mostly relied on large cloud providers and centralized compute. Ian shares a chart showing something different is coming.

item.title: Are You Addicted To Wall Street’s Favorite Drug?
item.description: 7 out of 10 Americans are addicted to a drug they don’t even know they’re taking. In a Gallup survey, 71% of U.S. investors said passive investing beats active stock picking for long-term returns, with only 29% taking the other side. They’re hooked on “buying and holding.” They buy shares in index funds and sit on them … forever.

item.title: A Fed Shakeup Could Change How Wall Street Sees Bitcoin
item.description: Ian says one of the names circulating as a potential replacement for Fed Chair Jerome Powelll could be a game changer for crypto markets.

item.title: Trade Less. Win More. Here’s When to Show Up
item.description: Most traders feel that they’re working hard. Especially if they’re following my process. They study the right patterns, learn from the best charts, and even execute solid trades. But they’re doing it at the wrong time of day. And it’s killing their progress. The market gives us a small window of opportunity every trading day. A stretch of time where stocks rip higher and charts show us clean patterns, free from clutter. If you miss this window, you’re making it harder on yourself.

item.title: Seeing Robotaxis In the Wild
item.description: Ian says the biggest obstacle in the robotaxi race is that autonomous driving companies are having to deal with the messy real world.

item.title: Market Volatility = Best Time to Be a Trader
item.description: It’s already the last week of January. Almost one month down. Eleven to go. And if this first month is any clue… 2026 isn’t slowing down. It’s speeding up. Last week alone, multiple small caps surged +100% while following my favorite trade patterns. The same setups. Same repeatable moves.

item.title: The Best Trading Angle Is Hiding in Plain Sight
item.description: Most traders hunt where the crowd is loudest. They read front-page news, look for headline spikes, or search for tickers from chatrooms. And as a result, they miss a repeating market setup right under their nose.

item.title: The Next Bottleneck in the AI Boom Isn’t Chips
item.description: Two years ago, Elon Musk predicted electricity shortages would be the next bottleneck for advancing of AI. According to Ian, he was right.
